messages:
Talia (PM): Quick sync — field wants two delivery patterns for private deploys: 1) slim operator (zero inbound ports, minimal surface) and 2) operator+relay with explicit customer-managed networking (preserve egress IPs, BGP handoff). Which do we GA first?
Raj (Eng-Infra): Slim operator first reduces ops burden. But relay is a hard blocker for larger customers. Could we GA slim and have a documented migration to relay?
Marta (Field): Customers with strict NetOps are pushing relay. They'll sign only if we guarantee egress preservation and a BGP dry-run. Small customers don't care and want fast onboarding.
Eli (Security): Relay requires more controls: mTLS between operator and relay, signed short-lived certs, KMS/HSM for key material, and audit events for every control plane action. We should list gating items before any GA on relay.
Sam (CS): Sales needs deterministic SLAs for both paths. For slim operator: "best-effort" networking (no preserved egress). For relay: explicit SLA around upgrade window and egress stability.
Talia (PM): Proposed plan: GA v1 = slim operator + upgrade path tooling. Relay will be beta (opt-in) with canary customers, then GA in next release after security sign-off. Launch acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- preflight: kube version >= 1.25, nodes >= 3, storageclass present
- network dry-run tool passes (simulated BGP, NAT mapping)
- KMS/HSM smoke: encrypt/decrypt test
- TLS cert rotation test pass
- upgrade/rollback validated on staging cluster
- docs: runbook + customer-facing SLA blurb
```
Raj (Eng-Infra): We need a migration CLI that records each step and a feature flag: `priv.operator.upgrade_mode = "inplace|relay"`. Migration command idea: `rictl migrate --tenant <id> --mode relay --dry-run`.
Marta (Field): Dry-run must produce a netops checklist output (BGP peers, expected AS path change, egress IP mapping). Customers want a copyable report they can hand to their network team.
Eli (Security): Add an automated TLS cert check that validates CA chain and key provenance (HSM-backed). Also require telemetry opt-in for debug logs during migration windows.
Sam (CS): SLA numbers proposal: slim/operator in-place upgrades: median 20m, 95p 60m. Relay-assisted migration: median 60m, 95p 3h (includes BGP convergence). We'll validate with canaries.
Talia (PM): Action items: 1) Raj: design migration CLI + feature flag (owner) 2) Eli: security gating checklist for relay (owner) 3) Marta: recruit 2 canary customers for relay dry-runs (owner) 4) Sam: draft SLA blurb (owner). I'll draft acceptance criteria doc and attach it here.
Raj (Eng-Infra): Implementation note: relay initial handshake should avoid inbound ports — plan to prototype a reverse-tunnel where the relay initiates an outbound TLS session to our control plane. Also add extensive logging for each hop.
Eli (Security): Reverse-tunnel acceptable with short-lived certs and HSM-signed bootstrap tokens. I'll define rotation windows and threat model.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: priv-operator v1.0.0-rc1 -> staging :rocket: (logs: https://ci.internal/priv-operator/1729987654)
Marta (Field): Once staging passes, I'll run a scripted dry-run with Customer-X next week. We'll capture timing, BGP convergence, and failure modes.
Talia (PM): Docs and runbooks are critical — devex + field owners please pair. Will follow up with acceptance criteria link. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
